Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.1 Integers (6 lessons) • represent integers on a number line • operati
Topic 1.2: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Fractions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Fractions
2. Solve practice questions on Fractions
3. Use Fractions in a real-life Kenyan example

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT FRACTIONS MEAN
A fraction names equal parts of a whole. In 1/2, the whole is split into 2 equal parts and you take 1.

WORKED EXAMPLES
A: Shade 1/4 of a rectangle divided into 4 equal parts.
B: 1/2 of 12 mangoes = 6 mangoes.
C: 1/4 of 20 = 5.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: 1/2 of 12 = 6

Example 2: 1/4 of 20 = 5

Example 3: 3/4 means 3 equal parts out of 4

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Fractions.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Fractions in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Show your working for every Fractions question.
2. Check answers by estimating or by a second method.
3. Link every skill to a real-life example.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
